equation_summary: Tucker attention factorizes Q/K/V and the output via a Tucker decomposition (core tensor + factor matrices). Pre: Q_tilde=x@Us_pre[0], K_tilde=x@Us_pre[2], V_tilde=x@Us_post[0], and a score core B_pre=einsum(Us_pre[1],Core_pre) folded into the score; the flash path computes softmax attention of Q_tilde against K_tilde with the B_pre core (FlashAttentionTucker), non-flash path does explicit einsum att=softmax(q k^T/scale, causal mask) then y=einsum(att,v). Output is reconstructed by the post Tucker folding (_tucker_foldings_output). The mixer reduction is plain softmax; factorization is external.
state_shape: standard attention; factorized Q/K/V (and output) via Tucker core+factors, optional low-rank cache of factor tensors
normalization: softmax (flash Tucker path / explicit softmax in the non-flash path)
